verdict.rationale: Adyen markets payments 'under your own brand embedded into your software' and 'branded financial products'. Its docs show API control over balance accounts (Configuration API) and custom payouts, which a platform could surface under its own brand. However, the pack shows no white-label embeddable components for seller balances, payouts or transaction history, and no API for reading balances or transaction history. Missing for 10: documented embeddable seller-facing UI components, an API for retrieving balances and transaction history, independent or hands-on corroboration of white-label seller dashboards.

support.subject: As a developer, seller-facing surfaces are embeddable — white-label components or APIs for balances, payouts, and transaction history that live inside my product under my brand

citations.quote: Offer payments under your own brand embedded into your software.
